“Empire City we have correspondence and reporting on the war from our own accounts. Taking the fight to the air, this is your host Captain Finn Midask with the truth.

Yesterday afternoon an important member of the Continental Banking Alliance put faith in the crew of the Wounded Duck to be smuggled past enemy lines for an important meeting. This critical backer keeping the patriot’s interest’s funded is a high value target that the revolution could not afford to lose. 

Valiantly, yankees of our beloved cities snuck into the skies and blew past a set of high border patrol airships. Outright crippling one and outrunning the other before any reinforcements could react gave us the head start we needed to deliver him safely.

Ensuring the city’s future by funding the rebellion is something every person should and can take part in. With a price as low as 16 gold per stock, it is a steal. Theydies and gentlethems I must repeat, head to Wallstreet and purchase as much CON stock as you can. That is Continental Currency Bills and together, we can fund a better tomorrow. Whether you’re a house spouse, pigeon wrangler, or keen adventurer, this is a choice we all profit with.

In addition to this escort mission I had the pleasure of joining an undercover sabotage mission to steal airships for our cause. You may have heard of the Cloud Giant. A magnificently built terror in the skies. That’s no cloud, that’s a lobster tank.

Together, heroes of the resistance infiltrated their flying fortress and stole a score of ships and crippled many more. A day is soon coming that we will find air superiority in our own skies once again, but until then, prepare your crews and get ready. More details on raiding opportunities to come, stop by the Samuel Adams for more.
